findings: crates/mori/Cargo.toml and root Cargo.toml: retains default = ["native"] while gating mori-backend, mori-ledger, futures, rand, and the 8 Midnight crates (promoted from dev-dependencies to optional dependencies) behind native; root Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are unchanged, crates/mori has no tokio or tower-lsp, crates/mori-core keeps midnight-compat-tests non-default, and the 11 native integration test targets (check_compile_io, check_static_compile_io, prepare_call, installed_call, signed_installed_call, native_proofs, signed_intents, replay, replay_challenge, enforcement_report, mapped_role_static_io) require feature = "native".

crates/mori/src/cli.rs, main.rs, error.rs, and commands/mod.rs: preserves the full clap CLI schema with cfg_attr(not(feature = "native"), command(after_help = ...)) notices and centralizes commands::native_unavailable() returning CliError::Operation { code: "mori::command::native-unavailable", ... } (stderr via Shell::report, exit 1; clap syntax/conflict errors exit 2) with no fallback execution.

crates/mori/src/commands/{compile,compile_call,keygen_call,keygen_signed_call,prepare_call,prepare_signed_call,prove,prove_call,prove_signed_call,replay,verify,verify_call,verify_signed_call}.rs and {call_io,proof_io,signed_call_io,core_io}.rs: gates all native implementations, backend/ledger helpers, and module unit tests under feature = "native", provides no-native run() wrappers that touch parsed Args fields and immediately return native_unavailable() before any file/key/proof/target I/O, and keeps core_io unconditionally exporting only read_source (1 MiB cap), operation, read_json, program, print, and review_identity.

crates/mori/src/commands/{inspect,simulate,intent,verify_intent}.rs: enforces exact refusal and companion precedence without native—inspect::run refuses --target via native_unavailable() before any source or target I/O even for Core 2 programs (while retaining native Core 2 profile refusal precedence before target read), simulate::run preserves --logical-cap/--trace conflict and legacy "--action and --scenario are required without --resume" checks before returning native_unavailable() on --trace, and intent/verify_intent validate companion profile arguments (including "--profile moriarty-jubjub-owner-intent/1 requires --target and --at together") before returning native_unavailable().

RUST_GUIDELINES.md, plugins/moriarty-dev/skills/develop/references/rust.md, and crates/mori/tests/{core_continuations,fee_pool_component,stage_test_public,core_test_report,logical_meter}.rs: records narrow CLI binary test and existing fixture/remount guideline exceptions, gates native-only test items in core_continuations.rs and fee_pool_component.rs under cfg(feature = "native"), and bounds the 3 selected integration targets to 12 SDK-free tests (2 in stage_test_public against R3 freeze ad44178b801dc51bfa6e254a2d9b48c18a4f7ea99e7b919be75730dc761cc34d + 8 mutations, 6 in core_test_report with expectation freeze 3911ef8990bbcdf067f641bcae032f48828b2035ddae55f8687969ecc0cb2395 and small stdout SHA-256 b57043f1d8fd55e80cfde729ef8e85f78225ff29129bc8da6696c7f1163e5118, and 4 in logical_meter).

PROPOSAL.json: defines a tightly bounded, single-attempt (attemptLimit=1, 90s wall with 5s TERM->KILL grace, -j1, --test-threads=1, --frozen, --no-default-features, nativeAuthority=0) cold CLI test command for stage_test_public, core_test_report, and logical_meter using a 13-variable environment whitelist (no HOME or inherited vars), 4 SHA-pinned tool binaries, metadata-only absence verification of 14 ancestor Cargo config paths, and fresh owned cwd/CARGO_HOME/CARGO_TARGET_DIR/TMPDIR under /tmp/doctorwatson-cli-core-check-* with immediate cleanup.
limitations: Rust compilation and tests are unrun in CANDIDATE.json; static preservation of the 103 native function/literal regions does not establish runtime or default-native correctness, and default/native builds, unit/doc tests, and workspace/all-features remain excluded.

The security-authored native_feature_boundary test target (including runtime subprocess verification that no-native invocations of native subcommands exit without side effects or unexpected syscalls) is a separate pending source increment not included in this candidate or command.

Oracle and coverage boundaries remain unchanged: oracle/FREEZE.sha256 (481f6d56f12e87730ae7b05324a7563ef1ea311800e9177f88f1f1b1ca81e29a) and R3 stage reports (ad44178b801dc51bfa6e254a2d9b48c18a4f7ea99e7b919be75730dc761cc34d) were frozen post-implementation under blinding with all 14 R3 gaps open; fee_pool_positive_aggregate_retains_frozen_financial_outcomes checks post and effects (plus pre object and non-empty steps) across 87 accepted cases rather than full pre/steps or per-action work; logical_meter shares mori_core::parse/simulate for execution compatibility; and the 3 targets include zero strict-manifest cases.

PROPOSAL.json claims no aggregate child RAM, disk, or process-group resource bound and relies on stated TCB assumptions for the local 1.99.0 toolchain, /usr/bin/timeout, system linker/libraries, public Cargo registry/git caches (including workspace manifest/lock resolution reading cached unselected Midnight manifests), and build scripts/proc-macros in the selected SDK-free dependency graph.

summary: Independent whole-packet security review (Gemini 4 Argon High) of the 28-path CLI native feature-boundary candidate (baseCommit 2c2b9182a2a756ce3b722d1a2bcfa6a31014c901, prospectiveTree 23a78098cbdf690ac3b6f9a994f6d5033b869b18) and the single ordinary cold CLI test command in PROPOSAL.json.
